package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"path"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type AIPromptClient interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, request AIPromptExecuteRequest) (json.RawMessage, error)
}

type AIPromptExecuteRequest struct {
	ProviderCode       string         `json:"provider_code"`
	TemplateCode       string         `json:"template_code"`
	LanguageCode       string         `json:"language_code"`
	ResponseSchemaCode string         `json:"response_schema_code"`
	Variables          map[string]any `json:"variables"`
}

type MilestoneBuildPreview struct {
	Milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone `json:"milestone"`
	Starter   domain.StarterBuildResult           `json:"starter"`
	Contract  domain.ValidationContract           `json:"contract"`
}

type PartBuildPreview struct {
	Part       domain.PracticeTaskPart   `json:"part"`
	Milestones []MilestoneBuildPreview   `json:"milestones"`
	Starter    domain.StarterBuildResult `json:"starter"`
	Contract   domain.ValidationContract `json:"contract"`
}

type BuildUseCase struct {
	Builders  domain.BuilderRegistry
	AIPrompts AIPromptClient
}

func (useCase BuildUseCase) BuildMilestonePreview(ctx context.Context, project domain.PracticeTask, milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, part *domain.PracticeTaskPart) (*MilestoneBuildPreview, error) {
	starter, authored, err := parseStoredStarterWorkspace(milestone.StarterWorkspaceJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !authored {
		partTypeCode := ""
		if part != nil {
			partTypeCode = part.PartTypeCode
		}
		if useCase.Builders == nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		starterBuilder, ok := useCase.Builders.GetStarter(milestone.MilestoneKindCode)
		if !ok {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		starter, err = starterBuilder.BuildStarter(ctx, domain.StarterBuildInput{
			MilestoneKind:     milestone.MilestoneKindCode,
			StackCode:         milestone.StackCode,
			PartTypeCode:      partTypeCode,
			LanguageCode:      project.LanguageCode,
			PracticeTaskTheme: project.Theme,
			ConfigJSON:        milestone.ConfigJSON,
			Difficulty:        "normal",
		})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	contract, err := parseStoredValidationContract(milestone.ValidationContractJSON)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &MilestoneBuildPreview{
		Milestone: milestone,
		Starter:   starter,
		Contract:  contract,
	}, nil
}

func parseStoredStarterWorkspace(raw json.RawMessage) (domain.StarterBuildResult, bool, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("{}")) {
		return domain.StarterBuildResult{}, false, nil
	}
	var starter domain.StarterBuildResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &starter); err != nil {
		return domain.StarterBuildResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid stored starter workspace: %v", domain.ErrValidation, err)
	}
	if len(starter.Files) == 0 || len(starter.Entrypoints) == 0 {
		return domain.StarterBuildResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: stored starter requires files and entrypoints", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	files := make(map[string]struct{}, len(starter.Files))
	for _, file := range starter.Files {
		if !safeStarterPath(file.Path) {
			return domain.StarterBuildResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsafe stored starter path %q", domain.ErrValidation, file.Path)
		}
		if _, duplicate := files[file.Path]; duplicate {
			return domain.StarterBuildResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate stored starter path %q", domain.ErrValidation, file.Path)
		}
		files[file.Path] = struct{}{}
	}
	for _, item := range append(append(append([]string{}, starter.ReadOnlyFiles...), starter.EditableFiles...), starter.Entrypoints...) {
		if _, ok := files[item]; !ok || !safeStarterPath(item) {
			return domain.StarterBuildResult{}, false, fmt.Errorf("%w: stored starter references unknown path %q", domain.ErrValidation, item)
		}
	}
	return starter, true, nil
}

func safeStarterPath(value string) bool {
	return value != "" && strings.TrimSpace(value) == value && !strings.ContainsRune(value, '\x00') &&
		!strings.Contains(value, "\\") && !strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") &&
		path.Clean(value) == value && value != "." && !strings.HasPrefix(value, "../")
}

func parseStoredValidationContract(raw json.RawMessage) (domain.ValidationContract, error) {
	var contract domain.ValidationContract
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &contract); err != nil {
		return domain.ValidationContract{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid milestone validation contract: %v", domain.ErrValidation, err)
	}
	if contract.Version <= 0 || strings.TrimSpace(contract.Kind) == "" || len(contract.Stages) == 0 {
		return domain.ValidationContract{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone validation contract requires version, kind, and stages", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return contract, nil
}

func (useCase BuildUseCase) BuildPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx context.Context, project domain.PracticeTask, parts []domain.PracticeTaskPart, milestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) ([]MilestoneBuildPreview, error) {
	partsByID := make(map[string]domain.PracticeTaskPart, len(parts))
	for _, part := range parts {
		partsByID[part.ID] = part
	}
	result := make([]MilestoneBuildPreview, 0, len(milestones))
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		var part *domain.PracticeTaskPart
		if value, ok := partsByID[milestone.PracticeTaskPartID]; ok {
			part = &value
		}
		item, err := useCase.BuildMilestonePreview(ctx, project, milestone, part)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, *item)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (useCase BuildUseCase) BuildPartPreview(ctx context.Context, project domain.PracticeTask, part domain.PracticeTaskPart, milestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) (*PartBuildPreview, error) {
	previews := make([]MilestoneBuildPreview, 0, len(milestones))
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		preview, err := useCase.BuildMilestonePreview(ctx, project, milestone, &part)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		previews = append(previews, *preview)
	}
	return &PartBuildPreview{
		Part:       part,
		Milestones: previews,
		Starter:    aggregatePartStarter(previews),
		Contract:   aggregatePartContract(part, previews),
	}, nil
}

func (useCase BuildUseCase) GenerateBlueprint(ctx context.Context, request AIPromptExecuteRequest) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	if useCase.AIPrompts == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.AIPrompts.Execute(ctx, request)
}

func aggregatePartStarter(previews []MilestoneBuildPreview) domain.StarterBuildResult {
	result := domain.StarterBuildResult{
		Files:         []domain.WorkspaceFile{},
		ReadOnlyFiles: []string{},
		EditableFiles: []string{},
		Entrypoints:   []string{},
		PreviewConfig: map[string]any{},
		Meta:          map[string]any{},
	}
	if len(previews) == 0 {
		return result
	}

	fileIndexByPath := map[string]int{}
	readOnlySet := map[string]struct{}{}
	editableSet := map[string]struct{}{}
	entrypointSet := map[string]struct{}{}

	for _, preview := range previews {
		for _, file := range preview.Starter.Files {
			if _, ok := fileIndexByPath[file.Path]; ok {
				continue
			}
			fileIndexByPath[file.Path] = len(result.Files)
			result.Files = append(result.Files, file)
		}
		for _, path := range preview.Starter.ReadOnlyFiles {
			if _, ok := readOnlySet[path]; ok {
				continue
			}
			readOnlySet[path] = struct{}{}
			result.ReadOnlyFiles = append(result.ReadOnlyFiles, path)
		}
		for _, path := range preview.Starter.EditableFiles {
			if _, ok := editableSet[path]; ok {
				continue
			}
			editableSet[path] = struct{}{}
			result.EditableFiles = append(result.EditableFiles, path)
		}
		for _, entrypoint := range preview.Starter.Entrypoints {
			if _, ok := entrypointSet[entrypoint]; ok {
				continue
			}
			entrypointSet[entrypoint] = struct{}{}
			result.Entrypoints = append(result.Entrypoints, entrypoint)
		}
		for key, value := range preview.Starter.PreviewConfig {
			if _, exists := result.PreviewConfig[key]; exists {
				continue
			}
			result.PreviewConfig[key] = value
		}
		for key, value := range preview.Starter.Meta {
			if _, exists := result.Meta[key]; exists {
				continue
			}
			result.Meta[key] = value
		}
	}
	return result
}

func aggregatePartContract(part domain.PracticeTaskPart, previews []MilestoneBuildPreview) domain.ValidationContract {
	if len(previews) == 0 {
		return domain.ValidationContract{
			Version:   1,
			Kind:      "validation_contract_v1",
			Stages:    []domain.ValidationStage{},
			Links:     []domain.ValidationLink{},
			Workspace: domain.ContractWorkspace{},
		}
	}

	result := domain.ValidationContract{
		Version:   previews[0].Contract.Version,
		Kind:      previews[0].Contract.Kind,
		Profile:   previews[0].Contract.Profile,
		Profiles:  append([]string(nil), previews[0].Contract.Profiles...),
		Stages:    []domain.ValidationStage{},
		Links:     []domain.ValidationLink{},
		Workspace: domain.ContractWorkspace{},
	}
	requiredFilesSet := map[string]struct{}{}
	stageIDsByMilestone := map[string][]string{}
	stageIDsByLocalID := map[string]map[string]string{}

	for _, preview := range previews {
		stageIDsByLocalID[preview.Milestone.ID] = map[string]string{}
		for _, path := range preview.Contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles {
			if _, ok := requiredFilesSet[path]; ok {
				continue
			}
			requiredFilesSet[path] = struct{}{}
			result.Workspace.RequiredFiles = append(result.Workspace.RequiredFiles, path)
		}
		for _, profile := range preview.Contract.Profiles {
			if containsString(result.Profiles, profile) {
				continue
			}
			result.Profiles = append(result.Profiles, profile)
		}

		for _, stage := range preview.Contract.Stages {
			localStageID := strings.TrimSpace(stage.ID)
			if localStageID == "" {
				localStageID = fmt.Sprintf("stage_%d", len(stageIDsByMilestone[preview.Milestone.ID])+1)
			}
			prefixedID := prefixedPartStageID(preview.Milestone.ID, localStageID)
			stageCopy := stage
			stageCopy.ID = prefixedID
			stageCopy.DependsOn = prefixDependencyIDs(preview.Milestone.ID, stage.DependsOn)
			result.Stages = append(result.Stages, stageCopy)
			stageIDsByMilestone[preview.Milestone.ID] = append(stageIDsByMilestone[preview.Milestone.ID], prefixedID)
			stageIDsByLocalID[preview.Milestone.ID][localStageID] = prefixedID
		}

		for _, link := range preview.Contract.Links {
			localLinkID := strings.TrimSpace(link.ID)
			if localLinkID == "" {
				localLinkID = fmt.Sprintf("link_%d", len(result.Links)+1)
			}
			linkCopy := link
			linkCopy.ID = prefixedPartStageID(preview.Milestone.ID, localLinkID)
			linkCopy.DependsOn = prefixDependencyIDs(preview.Milestone.ID, link.DependsOn)
			result.Links = append(result.Links, linkCopy)
		}
	}

	orderedMilestones := make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, 0, len(previews))
	for _, preview := range previews {
		orderedMilestones = append(orderedMilestones, preview.Milestone)
	}
	siblingGroups := groupPartMilestonesByParent(orderedMilestones)
	strictDependencies := map[string][]string{}
	if part.IsStrictOrder {
		for _, group := range siblingGroups {
			for index := 1; index < len(group); index++ {
				prevID := group[index-1].ID
				currentID := group[index].ID
				strictDependencies[currentID] = append(strictDependencies[currentID], stageIDsByMilestone[prevID]...)
			}
		}
	}

	for stageIndex := range result.Stages {
		milestoneID, _, ok := splitPrefixedPartStageID(result.Stages[stageIndex].ID)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if parentID := findPartMilestoneParentID(orderedMilestones, milestoneID); parentID != "" {
			result.Stages[stageIndex].DependsOn = append(result.Stages[stageIndex].DependsOn, stageIDsByMilestone[parentID]...)
		}
		if deps, ok := strictDependencies[milestoneID]; ok {
			result.Stages[stageIndex].DependsOn = append(result.Stages[stageIndex].DependsOn, deps...)
		}
		result.Stages[stageIndex].DependsOn = uniqueNonEmptyStrings(result.Stages[stageIndex].DependsOn)
	}

	return result
}

func prefixedPartStageID(milestoneID, localID string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s::%s", milestoneID, localID)
}

func prefixDependencyIDs(milestoneID string, values []string) []string {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if trimmed == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.Contains(trimmed, "::") {
			result = append(result, trimmed)
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, prefixedPartStageID(milestoneID, trimmed))
	}
	return result
}

func splitPrefixedPartStageID(value string) (string, string, bool) {
	parts := strings.SplitN(strings.TrimSpace(value), "::", 2)
	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
		return "", "", false
	}
	return parts[0], parts[1], true
}

func groupPartMilestonesByParent(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) map[string][]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone {
	result := map[string][]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{}
	for _, item := range items {
		parentKey := ""
		if item.ParentPartMilestoneID != nil {
			parentKey = strings.TrimSpace(*item.ParentPartMilestoneID)
		}
		result[parentKey] = append(result[parentKey], item)
	}
	return result
}

func findPartMilestoneParentID(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, milestoneID string) string {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.ID != milestoneID || item.ParentPartMilestoneID == nil {
			continue
		}
		return strings.TrimSpace(*item.ParentPartMilestoneID)
	}
	return ""
}

func uniqueNonEmptyStrings(values []string) []string {
	set := map[string]struct{}{}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if trimmed == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := set[trimmed]; ok {
			continue
		}
		set[trimmed] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, trimmed)
	}
	return result
}

func containsString(values []string, needle string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == needle {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
